slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: You still own the code
slides.subtitle: Coding agents help, but they do not remove engineering ownership.

slides.title: Use the tools
slides.body: AI engineers are increasingly expected to use coding agents for syntax, boilerplate, and platform details.

slides.title: Keep ownership
slides.body: You cannot say: the agent implemented it and I have no idea how it works. The system is still yours.

slides.title: Review and ask
slides.body: Read what changed. Ask why files exist, where functions are invoked, and which pieces are platform-specific.

slides.title: Document the path
slides.body: When the agent finds a working route after failed attempts, save the commands and reasoning so the path is repeatable.
